summary: This Vegetarian Zucchini Lasagna is a feel-good meal that brings smiles around the table. Layers of tender zucchini, creamy ricotta, fresh veggies, and melty cheese make it hearty and satisfying—yet surprisingly light.
caption: This Vegetarian Zucchini Lasagna is a feel-good meal that brings smiles around the table. Layers of tender zucchini, creamy ricotta, fresh veggies, and melty cheese make it hearty and satisfying—yet surprisingly light. Zucchini is loaded with fiber, vitamins, and antioxidants, so this dish is not only delicious but nourishing too. It’s quickly become a family favorite!
